name: Setlist Index
description: Slim bridge: takes the index number of the current song from the state machine via the consequence 'Set Current Song (Index)' and reports it to the Setlist Dashboard (as OSC /song/index N). Triggering the clips stays with your existing action states.

Current Index Param.description: Alternative route: instead of the command, the state machine can set this parameter with 'Set Value'. Changes are reported to the dashboard as well.

Index.description: This song's fixed index number. It must match the setlist in the dashboard.
